**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 24 hits our preferred ASSIGN position on every material term:

- **24.1** — Customer may assign to an Affiliate or M&A successor (merger, reorganization, acquisition, sale of all/substantially all assets) without Vendor consent; only prompt notice and assignee assumption required.
- **24.2** — Vendor is restricted: no assignment, delegation of material performance, or transfer by change of control without our prior written consent (not unreasonably withheld for a capable, financially sound assignee), and never to a direct Customer competitor.
- **24.3** — Mutual reasonable-consent standard for all other assignments, with anti-circumvention (void attempted assignments).
- **24.4** — Customer's change of control gives Vendor no right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees, or reduce service; Vendor must cooperate with successor administrative changes.

Section 13.3 carries the carve-out through to licence transfers, and a document-wide search confirms no other change-of-control trigger or assignment restriction operating against us. Nothing in walk-away territory.
